_readme: Machine-readable repo map — the ONE source the .claude/hooks read (no more per-hook hardcoded tables). Sections: authoring_gates (path-glob -> owner skill that must be read before editing; drives gate_authoring_edits.py), command_gates + command_viewers (command-regex -> skills; drives gate_skill_commands.py), doc_coverage (per-doc source globs; drives check_doc_drift.py, P3). Path patterns in authoring_gates/doc_coverage.covers are GLOBS matched right-anchored via pathlib.PurePath.match (component-aware: '*' does NOT cross '/'). command_gates.patterns are Python REGEXES matched against command segments. Validate with .claude/hooks/validate_manifest.py.

authoring_gates.note: Also read author-zone (builder/lint/preview mechanics) AND the FEATURE GUIDE for what you're building: ant nest=docs/guides/authoring/ant-colony.md, cave/tunnel/ore=caves.md, coast/water=water.md, mine/cliff/camp=camps.md, blocks=blocks.md, forest=forest.md, houses=house.md (index: biome-feature-map.md). Walk CORRECTIONS.md (owner taste).

Also read add-object (the art pipeline). CHECK the unified registry FIRST — an id is valid if it exists in ANY of items/occupants/placeables.json (never conclude 'missing' from one file); never invent. Home any NEW entity in docs/product/economy/catalogs/ (run tools/data/catalog_coverage.py).

Determinism-critical server code. Also: bug-spawning (spawn/persist files), perf-tuning (hot loops), and the relevant docs/product/architecture/architecture_*.md (index: ARCHITECTURE.md) — UPDATE that architecture doc if you change behavior.
Balance change. Also read frontier-sync if you touch a hash-bearing behavior field (movement_style / flies_over_fences / predation geometry) — that's a determinism change.
Also read add-object if this is a NEW asset (not a re-do of an existing one's art).

command_gates.note: docker compose = server lifecycle (run-backend), or rebuilding the plugin before a test (test-changes)

_doc_coverage_readme: Per code-doc -> the source globs it is system-of-record for. Consumed by check_doc_drift.py (P3): if a covered source changed but its doc did not, nudge to update the doc (waivable). Legitimate overlaps exist (e.g. terrain.py serves roads/water/camps) and are resolved at consume-time by naming all covering docs under one waiver. kind:reference = index/style/brainstorm doc, NO covers (excluded from drift). Every glob is validated to hit >=1 real path by validate_manifest.py.
